blocks.title: Peer Support Groups
body: Confidential, judgement-free space to talk about whatever’s on your mind.
Topics, activities, & length can be tailored by request!

blocks.title: Volunteer Training
body: Learn how to support your friends & classmates! This training adapts Badger Supports’ peer support framework for any student or student group.
Get familiar with campus resources & gain hands-on practice in active listening, confidentiality, inclusive practices, & more.

blocks.title: Navigating Housing in Madison Workshop
body: Get a head start on Madison’s early and fast-paced leasing season. Sessions are tailored to the requesting audience’s needs!

links.label: Learn More on Our Housing Page!

blocks.title: Badger SPILL
body: Need to vent to a fellow Badger? Spill it!
Badger SPILL is written peer support from Badger Supports. Write what’s on your mind, whenever it’s on your mind, and a trained UW–Madison Student Supporter writes back. It’s confidential.
Badger SPILL does not provide crisis support. If you or a friend are in a crisis, please call 911 or the UHS 24/7 Mental Health Crisis Line: 608-265-5600, option 9.
